definition: Conservative observed lower bounds. Count one coherent correction batch only when retained evidence links it to focused checking. Model turns, reviewer resumes, raw finding totals, build-only reruns and tooling failures are not cycles.
limits: Additional copy instances stay in the existing copy family. Shared-account and quote-copy findings are accuracy defects, not newly inferred authorization failures or a requirement to implement quotation. Counts are not quality scores or comparative efficacy estimates.
late_addendum: The first publication review found a missed Single accuracy defect; one exact-root correction plus fresh affected renders and focused independent re-review adds one family and one evidenced cycle to Single. Earlier lower bounds remain historical.
